Problem Description
: DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA9-10 error
Troubleshooting
: We have checked the logs on SCB for better insight and here are our findings:
Just today after 09:48:21hrs, there was no error of QA09-10 found in the logs. Now both outlets are available & no active error flags on the SCB.
It’s possible that there is a loose wire or a misconnection, but given the number of errors, I believe it’s better to replace the contactor. We shouldn’t need to visit the site just for a regular wire check. Since we’re not sure which contactor is faulty, I suggest replacing both. Please also carry a spare contactor in case a replacement is necessary
Please let us know if additional support or clarifications are required from our side. Looking forward to your confirmation regarding the site visit.
